source: Reviewed against the CS2 Simple-base menu registry and feature guides on 2026-11-09. Development build groups describe controls reviewed in local source without a verified public release.

items.label: Aim assistance
items.desc: Adjust aim toward a selected target.
settings: Head, neck, chest or nearest hitbox

items.label: Global and weapon aim profiles
items.desc: Use shared aim settings and set overrides for weapon categories or individual firearms.
settings: FOV, smoothing, hitboxes and recoil settings

items.label: Target selection
items.desc: Tune which target the aim system selects.

items.label: Aim checks
items.desc: Control when aim assistance can activate.

items.label: Aim response
items.desc: Tune the movement and timing of aim assistance.

items.label: Hitbox adjustments
items.desc: Adjust where within a target the aim is directed.

items.label: Auto stop
items.desc: Reduce movement before an assisted shot.

items.label: Accuracy gate
items.desc: Wait for the configured accuracy condition before firing.

items.label: Auto fire
items.desc: Fire automatically when a target meets the aim conditions.

items.label: Backtrack
items.desc: Use recent target positions for aim selection.

items.label: Spray targeting
items.desc: Keep aim behavior consistent during a spray.

items.label: Aim indicators
items.desc: Customize the aim FOV circle and target line.
settings: Circle color, thickness, fill and gradient
Target-line color, thickness, dashes and glow

items.label: Lock-on and Silent
items.desc: Choose visible lock-on aim or the separate Silent mode with its own activation bind.

items.label: Combat presets
items.desc: Start with a bundled profile and adjust aim, trigger and recoil settings for your setup.

items.label: Motion Prediction
items.desc: Lead moving targets. Older profiles may call this Velocity Prediction.

items.label: Aim response modes
items.desc: Choose how the aim radius and smoothing respond as the target moves.

items.label: Aim recoil compensation
items.desc: Tune recoil compensation while using aim assistance.

items.label: Movement-aware recoil control
items.desc: Adjust compensation for movement and weapon stance.

items.label: Standalone recoil control
items.desc: Use recoil compensation independently of the aimbot.

items.label: Spray control
items.desc: Enable the menu's spray-control option.

items.label: Recoil dot
items.desc: Show recent shot recoil in a separate indicator with its own color and size.

items.label: Return crosshair
items.desc: Choose whether standalone recoil compensation unwinds after the shot counter clears.

items.label: Triggerbot
items.desc: Fire when a valid target is under the crosshair.

items.label: Trigger delay and bursts
items.desc: Configure firing delays and burst behavior.

items.label: Trigger checks
items.desc: Set the conditions required before firing.

items.label: Flick-fire
items.desc: Detect targets during a flick across the crosshair.

items.label: Trigger prediction
items.desc: Adjust trigger behavior for moving targets.

items.label: Trigger assistance
items.desc: Tune supporting trigger controls.

items.label: Trigger delay policies
items.desc: Choose how a target qualifies before a generated shot.
settings: Category and weapon overrides for penetration and minimum damage

items.label: ESP filters
items.desc: Choose which players to draw and how far away to show them.

items.label: Box ESP
items.desc: Frame players with a full or corner box.

items.label: Health and armor
items.desc: Show health and armor bars beside players.

items.label: Player names
items.desc: Display names with configurable placement and text styling.

items.label: Distance
items.desc: Display player distance.
settings: Position, font size, color and gradient

items.label: Weapon information

items.label: Skeleton
items.desc: Draw player bones and optional joint markers.

items.desc: Mark player heads with selectable styles.

items.desc: Display configurable player-state flags.

items.desc: Show player money alongside the ESP.

items.label: Ammo count
items.desc: Show player ammunition information.

items.label: Equipment
items.desc: Display equipment icons.

items.desc: Visualize player sound activity.

items.label: Player trails
items.desc: Draw movement trails behind players.

items.desc: Display movement speed beside a player. Older builds may label this Velocity.

items.label: Hat ESP
items.desc: Draw a decorative hat effect above a player.

items.label: Player glow

Damage radius, label and bounce markers

items.desc: Show hostages and optional hostage skeletons.

items.label: Skybox

items.label: Bloom and gamma

items.label: Fog

items.label: Weather

settings: Off, rain, snow, storm, ash, embers, dust or leaves

items.label: Map effects
items.desc: Adjust environmental effects.

items.label: Particle colors
items.desc: Recolor selected combat effects.

items.label: Particle animation
items.desc: Animate effect colors.

items.label: World presets

items.label: Weather designer
items.desc: Adjust weather type, density and particle appearance.

items.label: Skin changer

items.label: Weapon finishes
items.desc: Choose weapon paint kits and configure their appearance.

items.label: Knife changer

items.desc: Choose a glove model and finish.

items.label: Agent changer
items.desc: Choose an agent for the selected team.

items.label: Agent patches
items.desc: Select patches for supported agent slots.

items.label: Stickers
items.desc: Browse weapon stickers and edit individual slots.

items.label: Charms
items.desc: Choose a weapon charm and its placement.

items.desc: Apply local inventory selections to the chosen team.

items.desc: Choose a charm and adjust its pattern and position.

items.desc: Open cases within the local inventory system.

items.desc: Organize local items in named storage units with deposit and withdraw actions.

settings: Fire, reload start, draw and empty actions

items.label: Custom player and agent models

items.label: Custom weapon models

settings: World model and first-person weapon model

items.label: First-person arms and viewmodels

items.label: Equip and unequip models

items.desc: Browse curated CS2 model packages, inspect their previews and install supported resources into your local library.

items.desc: Import a folder of compiled player, weapon or first-person arms resources into the appropriate library.

items.label: Workshop packages
items.desc: Download selected supported Workshop model packages through the Repo.

items.desc: Equip a replacement knife model such as a voxel pickaxe. Unequip to restore the previous knife and finish.

items.label: Custom grenade and equipment models
items.desc: Replace compatible flashbang, smoke, HE, incendiary and decoy models, plus equipment such as C4 and Zeus.

settings: CT, T, Both and Shared default

items.desc: Install selected packages, refresh the library or repair missing files.

items.desc: Compatible imported model bundles can supply fire, reload, draw or empty sound events. Explicit per-weapon sound settings take priority.
